senses.gloss:
stūpa (CII 3; BL; LL), technical name of a type of Buddhist monument; a Buddhist structure enshrining relics. Sometimes the term ratna-gṛha (i. e. the house enshrining the three ratnas or the best amongst the three) seems to be used to denote a stūpa.
 (EI 2), a Jain religious establishment.
 (SITI), pinnacle of a temple.
stupī, same as vimāna (IA 9), q. v.
